selected_evidence.requirement: Local contractor account created and usable
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline showed the account absent; subsequent checks showed its local passwd entry, correctly owned home directory, and successful execution as UID/GID 1000 before and after reboot.

selected_evidence.requirement: Password configured with 60-day expiration and 10-day warning
selected_evidence.summary: Credential assignment used node-local randomness; direct shadow checks showed `password_state=[REDACTED]], `max_days=60`, and `warn_days=10`, including after reboot.

Captured healthy baseline boot ID d9f8550d-5cb3-4929-9e62-a388df86bcf6, safe-reboot acknowledgement, new boot ID fa080d98-d978-418d-9b1a-92c00cc12e1b, system state `running`, and recovered account data.

commands.command:
set -eu
printf 'node=%s ip=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME" "$NODE_IP"
printf 'effective_uid='; id -u
printf 'os='; . /etc/os-release; printf '%s %s\n' "$ID" "$VERSION_ID"
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
if getent passwd contractor >/dev/null; then getent passwd contractor; chage -l contractor; else printf 'contractor_state=absent\n'; fi

set -eu
useradd --create-home --shell /bin/bash contractor
contractor_password=[REDACTED]]] rand -base64 36 | tr -d '\n')
printf 'contractor:%s\n' "$contractor_password" | chpasswd
unset contractor_password
chage -M 60 -W 10 contractor
printf 'account_creation=complete\npassword_assignment=[REDACTED]]],warn_days_10\n'
commands.stdout:
bash: line 3: openssl: command not found
account_creation=complete
password_assignment=[REDACTED]]]]
aging_policy=max_days_60,warn_days_10

commands.command:
set -eu
contractor_password=[REDACTED]]] if=/dev/urandom bs=48 count=1 status=none | base64 | tr -d '\n')
[ "${#contractor_password}" -ge 32 ]
printf 'contractor:%s\n' "$contractor_password" | chpasswd
unset contractor_password
chage -M 60 -W 10 contractor
printf 'credential_source=/dev/urandom\n'
passwd -S contractor

set -eu
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'system_state='; systemctl is-system-running
awk -F: '$1 == "contractor" { found++; printf "local_passwd_user=[REDACTED]]] uid=%s gid=%s home=%s shell=%s\n", $1, $3, $4, $6, $7 } END { exit(found == 1 ? 0 : 1) }' /etc/passwd
awk -F: '$1 == "contractor" { found++; if ($2 == "") state="empty"; else if ($2 ~ /^!|^\*/) state="locked"; else state="set"; printf "password_state=[REDACTED]]] last_change_day=%s max_days=%s warn_days=%s\n", state, $3, $5, $6; valid=(state == "set" && $5 == 60 && $6 == 10) } END { exit(found == 1 && valid ? 0 : 1) }' /etc/shadow
printf 'home_owner='; stat -c '%U:%G mode=%a' /home/contractor
printf 'identity_check='; runuser -u contractor -- id
printf 'aging_report:\n'; chage -l contractor
commands.stdout:
boot_id=d9f8550d-5cb3-4929-9e62-a388df86bcf6
system_state=running
local_passwd_user=[REDACTED]]]] uid=1000 gid=1000 home=/home/contractor shell=/bin/bash
password_state=[REDACTED]]]] last_change_day=20699 max_days=60 warn_days=10
home_owner=contractor:contractor mode=700
identity_check=uid=1000(contractor) gid=1000(contractor) groups=1000(contractor) context=system_u:system_r:unconfined_service_t:s0
aging_report:

printf 'pre_restart_boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
systemd-run --quiet --unit=[REDACTED] --on-active=3s /usr/bin/systemctl reboot
printf 'restart_acknowledged=scheduled_safe_systemd_reboot\n'

systemctl status [REDACTED].timer [REDACTED].service --no-pager || true
systemctl list-timers [REDACTED].timer --all --no-pager || true

set -eu
previous_boot_id='d9f8550d-5cb3-4929-9e62-a388df86bcf6'
current_boot_id=$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)
[ "$current_boot_id" != "$previous_boot_id" ]
printf 'post_restart_boot_id=%s\nboot_id_changed=yes\n' "$current_boot_id"
printf 'system_state='; systemctl is-system-running --wait

printf 'home_owner='; stat -c '%U:%G mode=%a' /home/contractor
